title: Settings
lead: Company profile, billing rules, automation, e-mail and security of your store.

errors.range: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
errors.list: Enter comma-separated whole numbers between {min} and {max}.
errors.country: Enter a two-letter country code (e.g. TR).
errors.hosts: Enter valid host names, one per line.
errors.link: Enter a full http(s):// address or a path starting with /.
errors.prefix: Use up to 12 letters, digits or the characters - _ / .

limits.staff: Your plan's staff limit has been reached. Upgrade the plan to add more team members.
limits.custom_domains: Your plan's custom domain limit has been reached.
limits.clients: Your plan's client limit has been reached. Upgrade the plan to add more clients.
limits.services: Your plan's service limit has been reached. Upgrade the plan to accept more orders.
limits.integrations: Your plan's integration limit has been reached.

localization.lead: Default language, currency and time zone of the store and the panels.
localization.section_lead: Used for visitors without a preference, new clients, invoices and dates.
localization.default_locale_hint: Pages without a language prefix use this language.
localization.default_currency_hint: Prices and invoices of new clients use this currency.
localization.timezone_hint: Dates, due dates and scheduled tasks follow this time zone.

billing.lead: Invoice numbering, due dates, reminders, suspension and late fees.
billing.numbering_lead: Applies to invoices issued from now on.
billing.invoice_prefix_hint: Letters, digits and - _ / . only, e.g. INV-.
billing.payment_terms_days_hint: Days between issuing a manual invoice and its due date.
billing.invoice_days_before_due_hint: How many days before the renewal date the invoice is issued.
billing.late_fee_lead: Added once to an overdue invoice. Set the amount to 0 to disable.
billing.prices_include_tax_hint: Catalogue prices are gross; the tax is calculated out of them.
billing.b2b_tax_exempt: Exempt foreign businesses with a tax number
billing.b2b_tax_exempt_hint: Reverse charge for business clients outside the home country.
billing.apply_credit_automatically: Apply account credit to new invoices automatically
billing.auto_charge_stored: Charge stored cards automatically on the due date
billing.funds_lead: Limits of the amounts clients can add to their account credit.
billing.credit_balance_max_hint: Includes unpaid top-up invoices; 0 means no limit.
billing.payments_lead: Where clients may be sent back after paying through the API (return and cancel addresses).
billing.return_url_hosts_hint: Exact host names, one per line (no https://, no paths, no wildcards). The shop's own domains are always allowed; anything else is refused.

orders.lead: Order acceptance, terms and domain defaults.
orders.auto_accept_hint: Paid orders are set up without waiting for staff approval.
orders.terms_url_hint: Shown at checkout; clients must accept it. Leave empty to use the terms page of the footer.
orders.nameservers_hint: One per line; used for new registrations.

security.lead: Password rules, two-factor authentication and session lifetimes.
security.staff_2fa_required_hint: Staff without 2FA are sent to the set-up page after signing in.
security.enable_own_2fa_first: Turn on two-factor authentication for your own account first.
security.cannot_disable_2fa: Two-factor authentication is required for staff in this store, so it can't be turned off.
security.sessions_lead: Signed-in users are logged out after inactivity or when the maximum session age is reached.

registration.allow_registration_hint: When off, accounts are created by staff or at checkout only.
registration.require_email_verification: Require e-mail verification before the first sign-in
registration.social_lead: Buttons are shown only when the provider is also configured under Integrations.

general.company_lead: Shown on invoices, e-mail footers and the storefront.
general.company_name_hint: Shown in the storefront header and e-mails.
general.used_on: These details appear on invoices and in the footer of every e-mail.
general.brand_lead: Used by the storefront and the client panel.
general.contrast_warning: {color} has a contrast of {ratio}:1 with white text; at least 4.5:1 is recommended for readability.
general.images_lead: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; favicon PNG or ICO. SVG files are not accepted.
general.logo_hint: Up to 512 KB; a wide image about 200 × 48 px works best.
general.favicon_hint: Up to 128 KB; square, at least 32 × 32 px.
general.too_large: The file is too large (maximum {kb} KB).
general.bad_image: Unsupported file. Upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
general.bad_favicon: Unsupported file. Upload a PNG or ICO icon.
general.bad_dimensions: The image dimensions are invalid or too large.
general.brand_moved: The brand and secondary colours now live on the Appearance tab, together with the design template and fonts.

domains.lead: Addresses your store and panels answer on.
domains.added: The domain was added. Create the DNS record below and verify it.
domains.not_verified: The DNS record could not be found yet. Changes can take a while to propagate.
domains.verify_first: Verify the domain before making it primary.
domains.cannot_remove: The primary domain and the platform subdomain can't be removed.
domains.taken: This domain is already in use.
domains.howto_2: Point it to {target} with a CNAME record, or add the TXT record shown in the list.
domains.howto_3: Click "Verify now". Once verified, you can make it the primary address.

automation.lead: Scheduled tasks run by the background worker.
automation.cron_hint: Six fields: second minute hour day month weekday (e.g. 0 0 6 * * *).
automation.queued: The task was queued and will run shortly.
automation.unknown_kind: This task can't be started manually.

help.daily_automation: Renewal invoices, reminders, late fees, suspensions and terminations.
help.sync_domain_status: Refreshes expiry dates and statuses from the registrars.
help.sync_tld_pricing: Updates domain extension costs from the registrars.
help.sync_usage: Collects disk and bandwidth usage from the servers.
help.einvoice_sweep: Issues pending e-Fatura / e-Arşiv documents, polls their status and handles refunds.
help.cleanup: Removes expired sessions and old job records.

email.sender_lead: Name and address e-mails are sent from.
email.from_address_hint: Must be allowed by your mail provider (SPF / DKIM).
email.no_mailer: No active mail integration: e-mails are recorded but not delivered.
email.templates_lead: Customise the subject and content of each e-mail per language.
email.subject: Subject
email.body_html_hint: Wrapped in the branded e-mail layout automatically.
email.body_text_hint: For mail clients that don't show HTML.
email.variables_lead: Available in the subject and both contents.
email.syntax_hint: Use {{#if x}}…{{/if}} and {{#each list}}…{{/each}} for conditions and lists. Values are escaped automatically.
email.syntax_error: The template has a syntax error: {error}
email.render_error: The template could not be rendered: {error}
email.test_hint: Leave empty to send it to yourself.
email.reset_confirm: Discard the customised text and use the default?
email.reset_done: The template was reset to the default.
email.log_lead: The last 25 e-mails of this store.
email.log_empty: No e-mails have been sent yet.

staff.title: Staff
staff.lead: Team members, invitations and what each of them may do.
staff.roles_lead: A member gets every permission of every role they have.
staff.roles_hint: Roles holding permissions you don't have yourself can't be given or taken away by you.
staff.invite_hint: An invitation link valid for 7 days is e-mailed; the account is created when it is accepted.
staff.no_assignable_roles: There is no role you are allowed to assign.
staff.invites_lead: Invitations that haven't been accepted yet.
staff.revoke_confirm: Revoke this invitation? The link will stop working.
staff.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this account? All of its sessions will end immediately.
staff.deactivate_hint: Deactivated members can't sign in; their history is kept.
staff.deactivated: The account was deactivated and its sessions were ended.
staff.reset_2fa_confirm: Turn off two-factor authentication for this member? They will be signed out.

errors.escalation: You can only give or take away permissions you have yourself.
errors.self_escalation: You can't raise your own permissions.
errors.last_owner: The last active owner can't lose the owner role or be deactivated.
errors.self: You can't do this to your own account.
errors.outranked: This member has permissions you don't have, so you can't change their account.
errors.email_taken: A user with this e-mail address already exists.
errors.invite_used: This invitation has already been accepted.

roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: Built-in roles can't be changed; create custom roles for other combinations.
roles.name: Role name
roles.form_lead: Tick what members of this role may do. "Manage" includes viewing.
roles.readonly_lead: Built-in role: its permissions can't be changed.
roles.matrix_lead: Areas of the admin panel and the allowed action in each.
roles.matrix_hint: Permissions you don't have yourself are disabled.

errors.name: Enter a role name of at least 2 characters.
errors.taken: A role with this name already exists.
errors.system: Built-in roles can't be changed or deleted.
errors.in_use: The role still has members. Assign them another role first.

invite.title: Join the team
invite.lead: You were invited as {email}. Choose a password to create your account.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
invite.email_taken: An account with this e-mail address already exists. Sign in instead.
invite.limit: The team is full at the moment. Ask the person who invited you.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.all_read: All notifications were marked as read.

link.done: The account was linked. You can now sign in with it.
link.taken: This provider account is already linked to another user.
link.unverified: The provider did not confirm the e-mail address of this account, so it can't be linked.
link.session: Your session changed during linking. Sign in and try again.

developer.title: Developer
developer.lead: API keys for integrations and outgoing webhooks for your own systems.
developer.revoke_confirm: Revoke this key? Applications using it stop working immediately.
developer.new_key_lead: The key acts as you, limited to the scopes you choose.
developer.expires_days_hint: Leave empty for a key without expiry.
developer.scopes_hint: Only permissions you hold are listed. A key never gets more than its owner currently has.
developer.secret_once: Copy it now: it is shown only once and can't be retrieved later.
developer.webhooks_lead: HostingOS sends a signed POST request to these addresses when an event happens.
developer.webhook_lead: Events are delivered as JSON with an HMAC-SHA256 signature; failed deliveries are retried.
developer.url_hint: https:// only. Private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused.
developer.url_https: The address must start with https://.
developer.url_private: The address points to a private or internal network and can't be used.
developer.url_unresolvable: The host name could not be resolved.
developer.url_invalid: Enter a valid https:// address without credentials.
developer.deliveries_lead: The latest 50 deliveries of this endpoint.
developer.inactive: Turn the endpoint on before sending a test.
developer.rotate_confirm: Create a new signing secret? The old one stops working immediately.
developer.signature_hint: Verify each request with this secret; the signature is in the header:
developer.how_text: After saving you get a signing secret. Every delivery carries the event name, a unique event id and a timestamped signature so your system can verify and de-duplicate it.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Revenue, growth, tax and receivables. Every figure is shown per currency; currencies are never added together.
reports.adjusted: The filter was adjusted: ranges are limited to three years, and daily or weekly periods are coarsened for long ranges.
reports.other_currencies: There is also data in {list}. Pick that currency to see it; amounts in different currencies are never summed.
reports.by_period_lead: Collected payments in {currency}, minus refunds and chargebacks.
reports.mrr_hint: MRR and ARR reflect active services today; churn and new services refer to the selected range.
reports.flow_lead: New clients, new recurring services and ended services per period.
reports.basis_accrual_hint: Invoices issued within the range, paid or not.
reports.as_of: Unpaid invoices as of {date}, grouped by days past due.
reports.per_currency: One row per currency; totals are never combined across currencies.
reports.domains_hint: The domain portfolio is a snapshot of today; the date range does not apply to it.
reports.renewals_empty: No domains expire in this window.

appearance.template_lead: How your storefront, cart, sign-in pages and client area look. Each template brings its own fonts, corner radius and colour mode; you can change all of them below.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: Warm paper tones, hairlines and ink buttons. Calm, editorial and technical.

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.description: Large headlines, a restrained brand gradient and rounded, elevated cards: a modern startup look.

corporate.name: Corporate
corporate.description: Navy and white, a structured grid, table-style plan comparison and trust signals up front.

terminal.name: Terminal
terminal.description: Dark-first, with monospace accents and terminal-window details for a developer audience.

studio.name: Studio
studio.description: Warm colours, big rounded forms and geometric drawings: a friendly look for small businesses and agencies.

editorial.name: Editorial
editorial.description: Large serif headlines, generous whitespace and fine rules: a calm, premium publication look.

atlas.name: Atlas
atlas.description: A deep brand-tinted hero with a server rack of your product groups, spec-sheet plans and hairline tables: for companies that sell servers by specification.

appearance.colors_lead: The brand colour is used for links, selected states and, in every template except Classic, primary buttons. The secondary colour appears in accents and decoration.
appearance.color_hint: Leave empty to use the template's own colour.
appearance.contrast_note: Text on coloured surfaces (black or white) is chosen automatically to stay readable, so even a very light brand colour keeps WCAG AA contrast.
appearance.type_lead: The fonts you choose are used on the storefront, in the client area, on the sign-in pages and in the admin panel.
appearance.font_hint: Every font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, supports Turkish characters and is served from your own server, so no visitor data goes to third parties. Pages download only the selected fonts.
appearance.body_sample: Reliable servers, honest pricing · İĞÜŞÖÇ ığüşöç 0123
appearance.shape_lead: The corner radius of cards, buttons and inputs, and the colour mode visitors see when they first open your site.
appearance.mode_toggle: Let visitors switch between light and dark
appearance.images_lead: Your logo for light and dark backgrounds and the browser tab icon.
appearance.images_text: The logo and favicon are managed on the General tab together with your company details; the selected template uses them automatically.
appearance.preview_hint: Unsaved changes are shown to you only.
appearance.preview_open: Open the preview in a new tab
appearance.reset_confirm: Colours, fonts, corners and colour mode will return to the selected template's defaults. Continue?
appearance.reset_done: Appearance reset to the template's defaults.
